Proposition
[Rademacher theorem on manifolds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0435 1. apph:H.2\group Euclidean convexity If $f:\M \to \R $ is locally Lipschitz, then $f$ is differentiable almost everywhere. In particular, distance functions are differentiable off a measure-zero cut locus.
